stemMd: Which city hosted the first meeting of the European Parliamentary Assembly in March 1958?
explanationMd: The European Parliamentary Assembly first met in Strasbourg in March 1958. It was a predecessor of today's European Parliament. The historical question concerns that meeting, not every later parliamentary workplace.

distractorRationale.d: This was not the location of that first meeting.

distractorRationale.b: This was not the meeting's host city.
distractorRationale.a: This city did not host the first Assembly meeting.
